source: Restaurant and bar picks from The Infatuation's French Quarter guide (updated Nov 2026) and Resy's 2026 New Orleans Hit Lists; coordinates and landmark details from Wikipedia, plus noma.org for the sculpture garden (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Jackson Square
spots.blurb: The French Quarter's historic central square, a National Historic Landmark ringed by street artists, the Pontalba Buildings and St. Louis Cathedral.
spots.blurbEs: La histórica plaza central del French Quarter, Monumento Histórico Nacional rodeado de artistas callejeros, los Pontalba Buildings y la St. Louis Cathedral.

spots.name: St. Louis Cathedral
spots.blurb: The landmark cathedral facing Jackson Square, one of the most recognizable buildings in New Orleans.
spots.blurbEs: La emblemática catedral frente a Jackson Square, uno de los edificios más reconocibles de Nueva Orleans.

spots.name: Pontalba Buildings
spots.blurb: Matching 1850s red-brick rowhouses with iron balconies lining two sides of Jackson Square, with shops and restaurants on the ground floor.
spots.blurbEs: Hileras gemelas de edificios de ladrillo rojo de la década de 1850, con balcones de hierro, en dos lados de Jackson Square; en la planta baja hay tiendas y restaurantes.

spots.name: New Orleans City Park
spots.blurb: A 1,300-acre park with centuries-old live oaks, lagoons, the New Orleans Museum of Art and the free Besthoff Sculpture Garden.
spots.blurbEs: Un parque de 1,300 acres con robles centenarios, lagunas, el New Orleans Museum of Art y el Besthoff Sculpture Garden, de entrada gratuita.
